{{Top|leg}}
'''Mechanized squad 1134.7''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military unit. Alongside [[mechanized squad 1134.8]], it was deployed as reinforcements during the Imperial [[Battle of Chakton|assault]] on the village of [[Chakton]].
